title: Vivy provider data
description: The single source of truth for provider configuration data (decision D1). Embedded at build time and validated at startup by internal/provider/vendor.go; this schema is the review surface for edits, and the Go validator is the authority. Additional rules that JSON Schema cannot express: (adapter, base_url) must be unique across the file; default_model must appear in that endpoint's models; a model id must not begin with its vendor's name or its adapter's name followed by '/'. Secrets never appear here: env_key is the NAME of an environment variable.

name.description: Vendor id. Unique across the file; also the value of config.providers.active and the UI row identity.

env_key.description: Name of the environment variable carrying this vendor's credential. Never a value. Several vendors may share one variable.

endpoints.description: One or more wire protocols for this vendor. A vendor speaking two protocols has two entries; the vendor's env_key is shared.

adapter.description: One of the sealed adapter families. openai-responses is DEFERRED-INDEFINITE: declaring it makes the capability visible, it is never executable.

base_url.description: Absolute http(s) base URL. Together with adapter it is the endpoint identity and must be unique across the file.

default_model.description: Must be one of this endpoint's models. Used when the user has not chosen a model.

capabilities.description: Closed endpoint-level capability vocabulary (DESIGN.md 3.3). A flag is legal only on an adapter that implements it; raw request injection is never accepted from data.

supports_prompt_caching.description: Enables automatic Anthropic cache breakpoints on this endpoint.

id.description: The endpoint's raw model id, sent verbatim on the wire. Must not begin with '<vendor>/' or '<adapter>/'; a slash is legal when it is part of the real id.

context_window.description: 0 or absent means unknown; consumers fall back to 128000.

input_per_mtok.description: Reference USD per million input tokens. 0 or absent means unpriced, never free.

output_per_mtok.description: Reference USD per million output tokens. 0 or absent means unpriced, never free.

supports_images.description: Absent means unknown; the image gate fails open for custom gateways.

supports_thinking.description: Absent means unknown; no reasoning parameters are sent.

provenance.description: D-025 review record: where this vendor's values came from and what was normalized.
